overview: Two-stage hierarchical routing architecture designed to evaluate learnable signal and bridge the district-routing gap on Delhi V5 cybercrime cases.

stage_1_district_routing.inputs: 25 pre-event case-level features only (no cluster or realization leakage)
stage_1_district_routing.leakage_protocol: 5-Fold Out-of-Fold (OOF) cross-validation on TRAIN. VALIDATION evaluated strictly with TRAIN-fitted estimator.

stage_2_pairwise_cluster_ranker.target: binary relevance within candidate pool (1 if candidate == realized_cashout_cluster else 0)
stage_2_pairwise_cluster_ranker.inputs: 60 features (54 canonical ranking features + 4 district posterior features + 2 historical priors)
stage_2_pairwise_cluster_ranker.routing_strategy: Soft routing via continuous posterior probability and rank features. Hard pruning avoided to protect cross-district cases against error propagation.
